slot_scores.name: inspection_cost_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about per-unit inspection/sales cost and whether it is charged per unit produced or sold, but never asked about or confirmed the 5500 yuan monthly inspection/sales cost budget cap.

slot_scores.name: overtime_limit_workshop_a
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether full utilization was a hard equality constraint, but did not ask whether overtime is allowed in workshop A or whether there is a 20-hour overtime limit.

slot_scores.name: minimum_water_heater_sales
slot_scores.evidence_quote: The brief gives "estimated average monthly sales next year: 80 microwave ovens, 50 water heaters" — is the 50 water heaters a minimum requirement (at least 50 must be sold), or is it just an estimate with no constraint attached?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the 50 water heaters figure is a minimum sales requirement, directly covering the hidden slot.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no monthly cap on inspection and sales costs; the 30/50 yuan per-unit costs are treated as purely variable expenses without an aggregate 5500 yuan limit.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about or confirmed the inspection/sales cost budget, yet the READY_TO_MODEL summary omits any such constraint and formulates the objective without it.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Workshop A capacity is fixed at exactly 250 hours with no overtime flexibility.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether overtime is allowed or limited in workshop A, but the READY_TO_MODEL summary treats workshop A as exactly 250 hours with no overtime option.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while two P1 hidden slots, the inspection/sales cost budget cap and workshop A overtime limit, remained unresolved.

summary: The agent clarified several important modeling points, including the water-heater minimum sales requirement, but missed two P1 business constraints: the 5500 yuan inspection/sales cost cap and the workshop A overtime limit. It then stopped prematurely with those P1 slots unresolved and silently assumed no cost cap and no overtime flexibility.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
